name: tictactoe
description: Tic-tac-toe (morpion) game service. Human plays X by default, the LLM plays O. To start / quit / query a game, publish on `game.tictactoe.command` with content either JSON `{action, mark?}` or a loose string. Recognised commands: `start` (optionally with `mark: 'X'|'O'` — default X), `quit`, `status`. The board is numpad-indexed 1-9 (1=top-left, 5=center, 9=bottom-right). Moves arrive on `chat.input` while a game is active — a single digit 1-9 is treated as a cell pick. Narrates every state change on `chat.response` so every connected chat surface stays in sync.

default_subscriptions.description: During an active game it's the player's turn input — a single digit 1-9 picks that cell on the board. Outside a game, plain text is ignored.

Game control plane. Publish `{"action":"start"}` or `{"action":"start","mark":"O"}` to start, `{"action":"quit"}` to abandon, `{"action":"status"}` to publish current state. Loose content like `start` or `start O` also works.
